title: Bringing Home the Bacon
start: Talk to Eli Bacon in his pig pen, by the Falador farm, north of Port Sarim.

items.t: 5 wheat (can be obtained during the quest)

recommended.t: Methods to get to East Ardougne, Draynor Village, Falador, Lumbridge, and Varrock.
Explorer's ring 3 or 4 (Falador cabbage patch), or skills necklace (Mining Guild)
Dave's spellbook to create 'Chipped' Falador teleports
1 earth rune, 1 fire rune, 3 water runes, 9 air runes and 5 law runes for fast teleportation to Varrock, Ardougne, Falador and Lumbridge
Construction materials to upgrade the machine after the quest
Tier two: 3 oak planks, 2 steel bars and at least 3 nails. Requires 44 in each of Summoning, Crafting, and Construction.
Tier three: 3 teak planks, 2 mithril bars, and at least 3 nails. Requires 84 in each of Summoning, Crafting, and Construction.

rewards.t: Ability to cook and eat bacon, bacon stacks, piles, heaps and mounds.
Ability to make three pig familiars:
A customisable pig pet. The name can be changed by Martin the Master Gardener and type can be changed by changing the pig machine by right-clicking on it.
Access to pig pens in Falador farm, Falador, Varrock, and East Ardougne
Weekly raw bacon (55 pieces) or familiar reward claimable from Eli.

steps.t: Speak to Eli in Falador Farm north of Port Sarim. [Chat: Accept]
Eat the piece of bacon he gives you. [Chat: ~]
Make sure you have at least 3 (better 6) free inventory spaces or Eli won't be able to give you planks
Speak to Eli again.
During the cutscene, avoid clicking too fast through the dialogue or you will have to restart the cutscene.
Build the hotspots and keep adding bacon until Eli has escorted the pigs away (focus on the middle one and they will all swarm to it).
Talk to Eli. Choose any 1 of the 3 show pig suggestions. [Chat: 1 Maybe they can fight?] or [Chat: 2 Maybe they can carry an altar?] or [Chat: 3 Maybe they can carry items?]
If necessary, gather 5 wheat from the field south-east of the Draynor lodestone.
Talk to Martin the Master Gardener in Draynor Village. [Chat: 3 Bringing Home the Bacon.] ( [Chat: 4 Bringing Home the Bacon.] if Vampyre Slayer is completed)
Go north-west of Martin and talk to each character (accuse each to quickly find the suspect). [Chat: 1 You're the one that picked Martin's pockets!]

sub.t: Continue until you have found the suspect (usually Pickpocket Dan)

steps.t: View cutscene after accusing.
Go back to Eli in the storm cellar and talk to him for construction materials. [Chat: 1 You broke your hammer on a hiker? › 4 I think I should go.]
Build the pig machine in the north of the cellar.

sub.t: Click a second time on the pig machine again to improve it.

steps.t: Speak to Eli. [Chat: 4 I think I should go.]
Speak to Eli again to give him the 5 wheat you gathered. [Chat: ~]
Go outside and put bacon on the decoys then poison them with the sleeping potion.
p: A group of Bacon addicts come to the farm in search of bacon.

steps.t: Talk to Eli.
Pick 5 onions just south of Draynor bank. These must be picked after having talked to him; you cannot use onions you already have, even if you picked them yourself.
Deliver the 5 onions to Eli. [Chat: ~]
Interact with pig machine.
Watch the cutscene about the pig.
Talk to Eli to receive a pig. [Chat: ~]
Take the pig to each location (a cutscene will play once you reach the correct area).

sub.t: Varrock Marketplace (in the centre of the fountain).
Falador centre (just south of the north gate).

p: Oh look! A piglet and a kitten!
Convincing villagers of the benefits of pigs.

steps.t: Return to Eli.
Quest complete!

p: The Pig emerges from the machine.
